motion.name: surgical-slide
motion.purpose: Smooth expansion from App to Nodal mode.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action trigger with an electric violet glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7c5cff; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.14s; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2), 0 8px 24px -6px rgba(124,92,255,0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #603ce2; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action with a subtle, muted border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #c9c4d8; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.14s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1a1e27; color: #e2e2e6; }

components.name: NSFW Badge
components.description: Luminescents indicator for explicit content levels.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor; } .ds-badge-mature { background: rgba(249,115,22,.12); color: #fdba74; border: 1px solid rgba(249,115,22,.3); }

narrative.overview: A high-precision control center for ComfyUI. It treats the LoRA and Model library as the primary interface, making the complex graph an implementation detail. The aesthetic is 'Dark Studio Pro', characterized by deep obsidian surfaces and luminous electric accents.
keyCharacteristics: Surgical Transition: Instant dive from App to Nodal mode.
Asset-Centric: LoRA palette is a first-class citizen.
Hardware-Aware: Automated VRAM management for 12GB cards.

rules.name: The Asset-First Rule
rules.body: The user should be able to complete a generation loop without ever manually creating a node.

rules.name: The Obsidian Rule
rules.body: Keep backgrounds deep and accents luminous to ensure imagery remains the focal point.

dos: Do prioritize the asset over the graph.
Do use the 'Surgical' transition for mode switching.
donts: Don't overload the screen with technical metadata.
Don't use generic Material Design defaults.
